module_summary: AXI4 register slice wrapper that instantiates separate write-channel (AW/W/B) and read-channel (AR/R) register slices between slave and master ports.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address entering the AW register stage of the write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data entering the W skid buffer in the write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address entering the AR register stage of the read slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave side from the R skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AW channel valid from upstream master into write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: W channel valid into the write skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: W channel ready back-pressure from write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid from registered B channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AR channel valid into the read slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid from the R skid buffer to slave side.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data driven to downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from downstream slave entering R register stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW channel ready from write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR channel ready from read slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave-side R ready controlling R skid buffer drain.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Registered write address to downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Registered read address to downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master-side R ready from read skid buffer.

groups.name: write_channel_slice
groups.description: AW/W/B register slice instance buffering write address, data and response.

groups.name: read_channel_slice
groups.description: AR/R register slice instance buffering read address and read data.
